findings.title: Restore success followed by MULTI_USER failure is classified as database not replaced

findings.title: Unvalidated signed delivery fee can bypass intended discount and comp authorization
findings.root_cause: Untrusted signed fee enters payable-total arithmetic without context/range validation; positive discount/comp permission gates do not cover a reduction encoded as negative fee. Money addition also permits unchecked large positive fee overflow.
evidence_chain: Signed Money accepts raw DeliveryFeePiastres. Handler does not zero non-delivery fee or reject negative fee in examined flow.
Base pos permission is required. Positive Discount and Comp fields have distinct permission/approval gates, but fee is added without such policy.

ComputePayableTotal adds fee then clamps negative result to zero. Zero amount-paid passes zero payable; plan DefersAllMoney suppresses sale collection while normal order/stock transaction still proceeds.
Order.Create copies plan fee/total rather than validating a nonnegative fee. No fee check constraint found in approved model/migration search.
findings.preconditions: Legitimate authenticated active pos actor; open shift; valid sellable order and ordinary database constraints. Does not require SEC001 actor mismatch. Negative-fee request is outside ordinary client validation paths; this is a server trust boundary.
findings.impact: A legitimate pos actor can construct a sale whose computed payable is reduced or zero without positive Discount/Comp fields triggering their extra authorization. Normal order/stock writes are predicted from source, not exercised on any database.
counterevidence: Legitimate full comps also permit zero payable but require separate approvals; this finding bypasses that intended route.
Foreign deployment trigger/additional validation not observed; no real HTTP/DB acceptance demonstrated.
Server still resolves product prices, quantities, tax and actor permission; no arbitrary unauthenticated sale claimed.
Ordinary UI may constrain fee entry; server must independently enforce accepted financial ranges.
Zero-payable legitimate authorized comps remain valid; signed Money is required by other financial domains and must not be globally prohibited.
Pure probe is a separate net10 audit binary linked to unchanged approved Domain source, not the deployed net8 app.
findings.recommendation: Validate fee sign, bounds and permitted order-type meaning at server boundary; use configured delivery pricing/approved override policy where required. Use checked bounded payable arithmetic with explicit validation errors. Preserve legitimate signed ledger deltas and approved comp flows; no code change implemented.
required_regression_tests: Restricted pos actor with negative/non-delivery fee rejected without order/stock/money changes in approved isolated DB fixture.
Boundary/overflow values for fee/subtotal/discount/comp; no wrap-to-zero.
Positive fee, ordinary zero-fee, insufficient amount, approved comps and COD retain intended behavior.
